newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Adultery charge trips Vietnam Assembly candidate.
newsitem.headline: Adultery charge trips Vietnam Assembly candidate.

text.p: A candidate for election to Vietnam's National Assembly has withdrawn from this month's vote after being accused of adultery, an official from the Central Election Council said on Wednesday.
He said Nguyen Van Bu, a member of the executive committee of Ho Chi Minh City's Communist Party unit and Chairman of the Farmers' Association, sent a letter admitting extra-marital relations.
His request to bow out of the election line-up was accepted.
Public information about the private lives of officials is extremely rare in Vietnam.
Bu was among 664 candidates nationwide who cleared several hurdles of approval to stand for election to the 450-seat legislature on July 20.
